source: US Preventive Services Task Force — Grade A & B recommendations
note: In production this file is refreshed on a schedule from the USPSTF published A/B recommendation set (and its data feed), so the EHR stays current as evidence changes. The app fetches it at load; editing this file updates the EHR with no code change.

recommendations.clin: Screen all adults; use a validated instrument and ensure systems for diagnosis, treatment and follow-up.
recommendations.pt: A quick, confidential check-in on mood — because mental health is health.

recommendations.clin: Screen adults 64 and younger, including pregnant/postpartum, when systems for accurate diagnosis and care are in place.
recommendations.pt: A short questionnaire about worry and stress you can complete privately.

recommendations.topic: Unhealthy Alcohol Use in Adults: Screening & Counseling
recommendations.clin: Screen adults ≥18 for unhealthy alcohol use; offer brief behavioral counseling to those who screen positive (Grade B).
recommendations.pt: A few private questions about drinking — no judgment, just support.

recommendations.topic: Statin Use for Primary Prevention of CVD
recommendations.clin: Offer a statin to adults 40–75 with ≥1 CVD risk factor and estimated 10-year risk ≥10% (Grade B).
recommendations.pt: A daily pill that lowers the chance of a heart attack or stroke — worth discussing given your numbers.

recommendations.clin: Biennial screening mammography for women 40–74 (Grade B).
recommendations.pt: A mammogram every 2 years — the best tool we have to catch breast cancer early.

recommendations.clin: Screen women ≥65, and postmenopausal women <65 at increased fracture risk, with bone density testing.
recommendations.pt: A painless bone-density scan that helps prevent fractures as you age.

recommendations.topic: Intimate Partner Violence & Caregiver Abuse of Older/Vulnerable Adults: Screening
recommendations.clin: Screen women of reproductive age for IPV; provide or refer to support services.
recommendations.pt: A private, judgment-free check on your safety at home — you can always ask to speak alone.

recommendations.clin: Screen all adults 45–75 (Grade A 50–75, Grade B 45–49). Colonoscopy, FIT, or other approved modality.
recommendations.pt: Colon cancer screening — you're due; several easy options exist.

recommendations.clin: Screen adults ≥18 with office BP, confirmed outside the clinical setting before diagnosis (Grade A).
recommendations.pt: Regular blood-pressure checks — you're already managing this well.

recommendations.clin: Annual low-dose CT for adults 50–80 with ≥20 pack-year history who smoke now or quit within 15 years.
recommendations.pt: If your past smoking qualifies, a yearly low-dose CT scan can catch lung cancer early.

recommendations.clin: Screen adults 35–70 who are overweight/obese; offer or refer to preventive interventions (Grade B).
recommendations.pt: Blood-sugar monitoring — central to your care and already underway.

recommendations.clin: Ask all adults about tobacco use; advise to quit; offer behavioral interventions and FDA-approved pharmacotherapy (Grade A).
recommendations.pt: Staying tobacco-free — you quit in 2019, one of the best things you've done for your health.

recommendations.clin: Offer PrEP to persons at increased risk of HIV acquisition (Grade A).
recommendations.pt: A medicine that prevents HIV, for anyone at risk.

recommendations.topic: Latent Tuberculosis Infection in Adults: Screening
recommendations.clin: Screen adults at increased risk for latent TB infection (Grade B).
recommendations.pt: A simple test if you have TB risk factors.

recommendations.topic: Syphilis in Nonpregnant Adolescents & Adults: Screening
recommendations.clin: Screen persons at increased risk for syphilis infection (Grade A).
recommendations.pt: An STI screen recommended when there's increased risk.

recommendations.clin: Screen sexually active women ≤24, and older women at increased risk (Grade B).
recommendations.pt: A routine STI screen when risk factors are present.

recommendations.topic: Folic Acid to Prevent Neural Tube Defects
recommendations.clin: Recommend 0.4–0.8 mg folic acid daily for those planning or capable of pregnancy (Grade A).
recommendations.pt: A daily vitamin before and during early pregnancy.

recommendations.clin: Low-dose aspirin after 12 weeks for pregnant persons at high risk of preeclampsia (Grade B).
recommendations.pt: A low-dose aspirin in pregnancy if you're at higher risk.
